Metadata.description: Langganin helps you track subscriptions & free trials, reminds you before auto-renewals hit, and sums up your monthly spending.

Topbar.searchHint: Press Enter to see all results

Landing.heroHeadlineAccent: Track all your subscriptions & trials in one place.
Landing.heroSubheadline: Monitor renewal dates, get reminded before you're billed, and sum up your monthly spend — in Rupiah and multi-currency, plus ask AI about your subscriptions.
Landing.feature1Desc: Netflix, Spotify, ChatGPT, or any trial — save price, billing cycle, currency, and payment method. Card or list view, your call.
Landing.feature2Desc: Choose how many days before a renewal or a trial ends you want a reminder — via Email, WhatsApp, or Google Calendar. Global or per subscription.
Landing.feature3Desc: Monthly & yearly totals, active subscriptions, category breakdown, and renewals due in 7 & 30 days — all at a glance.
Landing.feature4Desc: See renewal and trial-end dates in month or week view, then export to Google Calendar (.ics) or CSV.
Landing.feature5Desc: Spending trends, payment-method breakdown, and your priciest subscriptions. Got questions? Ask the AI assistant directly.
Landing.feature6Desc: Back up everything to a JSON file, import anytime, and delete subscriptions worry-free — restorable within 14 days.
Landing.indonesiaDesc: GoPay, OVO, DANA, ShopeePay, QRIS — your payment methods aren't just labels. Rupiah and Bahasa Indonesia as the default experience, with English for everyone. Built for how you pay and track.
Landing.statsMultiCurrencyDesc: IDR, USD, SGD, and more per subscription
Landing.statsRemindersDesc: Renewals & trial ends, global or per subscription
Landing.ctaDesc: Start tracking your subscriptions now. Free, no credit card required.
Landing.footerTagline: Made by Dzaki from Indonesia. Open source, free to use for anyone.

Login.title: Log in
Login.description: Log in with your email and password.
Login.errorEmailNotConfirmed: Please confirm your email before logging in.
Login.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Login.successConfirmed: Email confirmed! You can log in now.
Login.errorConfirmationFailed: Email confirmation failed or the link expired.

Register.title: Sign up
Register.description: Create an account to start tracking your subscriptions.
Register.passwordLength: Password must be at least 6 characters.
Register.errorEmailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
Register.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Register.successCheckEmail: Account created! Check your email to confirm your account.

Dashboard.title: Dashboard
Dashboard.description: Your monthly & yearly (projected) spending summary, renewals due in the next 7 and 30 days, and a spending-by-category chart will show up here.
Dashboard.noSubscriptions: No subscriptions yet! Start tracking your first one.

Subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
Subscriptions.description: All your subscriptions — with search, category & status filters, and an add-subscription button — will live on this page.
Subscriptions.bulkDeleteBody: {count} subscriptions will be moved to Recently Deleted and permanently removed after 14 days.
Subscriptions.categoryDeleteBody: All subscriptions in it will be moved to 'Uncategorized'.

SubscriptionDetail.title: Subscription Detail
SubscriptionDetail.description: The full edit form (name, category, price, billing cycle, trial, payment method, notes), event history, and a delete action for this subscription will show up here.
SubscriptionDetail.deleteBody: This subscription will be moved to Recently Deleted and permanently removed after 14 days. You can restore it any time before that.

Calendar.title: Calendar
Calendar.description: A monthly calendar view marking renewal and trial-end dates (colored by category) will live on this page.
Calendar.emptyDescription: Add a subscription first so you can see your calendar.

Analytics.title: Analytics
Analytics.description: Spending trends over time, category breakdowns, and call-outs for your priciest subscriptions will land on this page (Phase 3).
Analytics.chartRankingHint: Click a bar to view details
Analytics.chartRankingEmpty: No active subscriptions to rank yet
Analytics.chatDescription: Ask anything about your subscriptions — answers stream in token by token.
Analytics.chatErrorNoKey: AI is not configured. Add GEMINI_API_KEY to .env to enable chat.
Analytics.chatErrorGeneric: Couldn't reach the AI. Check your connection and try again.
Analytics.suggestedPrompt1: What's my total spending this month?
Analytics.noDataDescription: Add a subscription first so analytics can show a summary.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description: Manage your profile, preferences, notification defaults, and app data.
Settings.profileDesc: The name used for the header greeting and avatar initial.
Settings.preferencesDesc: Interface language and number formatting used across the app.
Settings.currencyFormatDesc: Thousands separator for prices and amounts.
Settings.currencyDesc: Used automatically for new subscriptions. Can be changed per subscription in the form.
Settings.notifDesc: Default reminders applied to new subscriptions.
Settings.notifHelper: Per-subscription overrides can be changed on the Notifications page.
Settings.payDesc: Favorite methods appear first when adding or editing a subscription.
Settings.dataDesc: There's no database yet — everything is stored in your browser. Back up manually here.
Settings.exportHint: Download a full backup of your data as a file.
Settings.importHint: Restore data from a backup file.
Settings.importConfirmBody: Your current data will be overwritten with the file's contents. Continue?
Settings.importError: Invalid file or not a Langganin backup.
Settings.resetHint: Delete all local data. This cannot be undone.
Settings.resetConfirmBody: This permanently deletes all subscriptions, preferences, and settings. Type RESET to continue.
Settings.aboutDesc: Langganin helps you track subscriptions & free trials, reminds you before auto-renewals, and sums up your monthly spending.
Settings.accountDesc: Sign out of Langganin on this device.

Notifications.title: Notifications
Notifications.description: Set reminders before subscriptions renew or trials end.
Notifications.emptyDescription: Renewal and trial-end reminders will show up here as the date approaches.
Notifications.settingsDesc: Choose when you want to be reminded before a subscription renews or a trial ends, and how the reminders reach you.
Notifications.globalDefaultsDesc: These apply to every subscription. Want something different for one of them? Customize it below.
Notifications.daysBeforeDesc: How many days before the renewal date do you want a reminder? You can pick more than one.
Notifications.trialDaysBeforeDesc: How many days before a trial ends do you want a reminder?
Notifications.trialDaysBeforeDisabled: Enable a trial period on this subscription to set trial reminders.
Notifications.channelsDesc: Choose one or more ways to receive reminders.
Notifications.perSubscriptionDesc: Want one subscription to remind you earlier? Customize its reminders here.
Notifications.comingSoonHint: Reminder delivery will be available soon.
